ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Britain in the Global Eighteenth Centruy Description: Britain and the Global Eighteenth Century interrogates Britain's national and imperial history in the long eighteenth century (1660-1830). The readings, cultural studies of geography, race, sex, gender, religion, and a special emphasis on law, will explore the global eighteenth century and the formation of the British empire. Our geographical range will include British Isles, India, East Asia, North America, and the Caribbean. We will also read theoretical works that inform studies of race, gender, and culture in and beyond eighteenth-century Britain. An interdisciplinary approach will allow us to engage various theoretical and methodological perspectives as we explore this topic.
